bio.text: Jessica González-Rojas has represented the 34th Assembly District in Queens, which includes Astoria, Corona, East Elmhurst, Elmhurst, Jackson Heights and Woodside, since taking office in 2021.

Before running for office she spent more than 13 years at the National Latina Institute for Reproductive Justice, including as Executive Director, and she has taught as an adjunct at New York University and the City University of New York.
She has a bachelor's degree in international relations from Boston University and a master's degree from the NYU Wagner School, and lives in Jackson Heights.

Ballotpedia lists her as the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Senate District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, rather than for re-election to the Assembly.
